name: Ceviche
description: Raw fish 'cooked' in lime juice with onion and chilli — minutes, not hours.

tcm.note: Raw fish in citrus, served cold.

ayurveda.note: Matsya and amla-rasa are both ushna, despite the cold plate.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; thanda in practice; a hot-climate dish.

histamine.note: Raw fish plus a great deal of lime — the acid denatures the protein but does nothing to histamine.
